column1: # Prefixes of the libc/POSIX docking units. #include is allowed here.
# A unit outside these prefixes is upper-layer and must not use #include.
# Each prefix ends with a slash.
# cx/sys/: the L0 sys packages (plans/cx-layers.md). These may include, for headers the prelude lacks:
#   cx/sys/lnx-x86_64.c is the one C file under cx/ outside a .cx module: the Linux process-group
#   syscall provider.  It docks __syscall6, so it sits in L0 with the other adapters.
# Exact entries, FILE<TAB>reason: the host-C side of the cx tree, plus header-surface probes. A probe
# tests a carried header in include/ by including it, so it belongs with the bottom layer it checks;
# a migration to use sys.* would remove the test.

column2: the fixed prefix cx0-extract projects to src/cxmod.c; it docks the carried unisa_sha256.h into the host-C build
